{{PAGENAME}} and '''Changshui''' can be found near a bunch of [[Moss Amber]] outside the [[Everfrost Cavern]]. Appears after {{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ji Liubai:''' Professor, is this Moss Amber? It's beautiful...
:'''Ji Liubai:''' Is it all moss inside?
:'''Changshui:''' Mostly. Some specimens preserve other plants as well.
:'''Changshui:''' This species of moss still exists in Lahai-Roi, but it has evolved into a form that no longer resembles what's encased in the amber.
:'''Ji Liubai:''' The forests prior to the frostlands becoming the pole must have been incredible. Even the moss in here looks like tiny flowers.
:'''Ji Liubai:''' I’ve seen reconstructed simulations in class, but the real forests must have been more breathtaking and vibrant.
:'''Ji Liubai:''' It’s a shame we can only imagine them through slivers of time preserved in amber. Just thinking about it makes me a little sad...
:'''Changshui:''' Instead of getting sentimental, why not join the Upphaf Forest Restoration Project? I'd be happy to approve you.
:'''Changshui:''' But if this is just empty talk, then forget about it. Don't be someone who only dreams and never acts, Liubai
:'''Ji Liubai:''' ...Understood, Professor. I'll give it serious thought.
{{Dialogue End}}
